title: Asymptotic dimension of graphs excluding an induced or fat minor
summary: Asymptotic dimension is a large-scale invariant of metric spaces that was introduced by Gromov (1993). A major open problem in coarse graph theory asks whether, for every fixed graph $H$, the class of graphs excluding $H$ as a fat minor has bounded asymptotic dimension. A weaker conjecture asserts the same conclusion for graphs excluding $H$ as an induced minor. We substantially expand the range of graphs $H$ for which these conjectures are known to hold.
